**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 11 ("Transition Assistance and Data Return") already delivers our preferred position, and in two respects improves on it:

- **11.1** — six months of transition assistance on our request, including knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier and continued service at existing scope/service levels, priced at the **rates in the expiring Order Form** (better pricing certainty than "then-current rates").
- **11.2** — return of all Customer Data within thirty days of request in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with relationships and metadata, and an express bar on withholding data over a fee dispute.
- **11.3** — deletion and written officer certification occur **only after we confirm successful return**, with any law-required retained copy remaining protected and use-restricted.

I also confirmed no competing early-deletion or access cut-off: Section 9 (Termination) is silent on data, Section 10.1 preserves access through the agreed transition period and preserves Customer Data rights, and Section 15 contains no termination-triggered deletion. The only deletion obligation in the document is the correctly sequenced one in 11.3.
